metadata.title: Windows Server 2025 default permissions for the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE registry hive must be maintained.

criterion.comment: Default permissions for the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SECURITY registry hive must be maintained.
Default non-Domain Controller permissions for the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE registry hive must be maintained.
The system is a Domain Controller.
Default Domain Controller permissions for the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM registry hive must be maintained.
The system is not a domain controller
Default non-Domain Controler permissions for the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM registry hive must be maintained.

independent-def:shellcommand_test.comment: Default Domain Controller permissions for the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM registry key must be maintained.

win-def:wmi57_test.comment: The system is a Windows Domain Controller

independent-def:shellcommand_test.comment: Default permissions for the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SECURITY registry key must be maintained.
Default Non-Domain Controller permissions for the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE registry key must be maintained.

independent-def:shellcommand_object.comment: Gather permissions for the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE registry
independent-def:shellcommand_object.independent-def:command: ([Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::LocalMachine.OpenSubKey("Software", [System.Security.AccessControl.RegistryRights]::ReadPermissions)).GetAccessControl().Access | Where-Object { $_.RegistryRights -notmatch '\d+' } | ForEach-Object { "Identity:$($_.IdentityReference), Rights: $($_.RegistryRights), Access: $($_.AccessControlType), IsInherited: $($_.IsInherited), InheritanceFlags: $($_.InheritanceFlags), PropagationFlags: $($_.PropagationFlags)" }

independent-def:shellcommand_object.comment: Gather permissions for the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE registry
independent-def:shellcommand_object.independent-def:command: ([Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::LocalMachine.OpenSubKey("System", [System.Security.AccessControl.RegistryRights]::ReadPermissions)).GetAccessControl().Access | Where-Object { $_.RegistryRights -notmatch '\d+' } | ForEach-Object { "Identity:$($_.IdentityReference), Rights: $($_.RegistryRights), Access: $($_.AccessControlType), IsInherited: $($_.IsInherited), InheritanceFlags: $($_.InheritanceFlags), PropagationFlags: $($_.PropagationFlags)" }

independent-def:shellcommand_object.comment: Gather permissions for the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SECURITY registry
independent-def:shellcommand_object.independent-def:command: ([Microsoft.Win32.Registry]::LocalMachine.OpenSubKey("Security", [System.Security.AccessControl.RegistryRights]::ReadPermissions)).GetAccessControl().Access | Where-Object { $_.RegistryRights -notmatch '\d+' } | ForEach-Object { "Identity:$($_.IdentityReference), Rights: $($_.RegistryRights), Access: $($_.AccessControlType), IsInherited: $($_.IsInherited), InheritanceFlags: $($_.InheritanceFlags), PropagationFlags: $($_.PropagationFlags)" }
